name: KANGER
recent: KANGER 因未能在期限内提交经审计财报，遭 Bursa 驳回延期申请，股票自 2026-11-03 起暂停交易。公司最新季度（截至 2026-08-31）录得 RM117.45 million 亏损，每股净资产降至 11.64 sen。
notable: Bursa Malaysia rejected KANGER's application for an extension of time to issue its audited accounts.。
Trading in KANGER shares was suspended on 3 November 2026.。
KANGER reported a quarterly loss of RM117.45 million for the period ended 31 August 2026.。
risks: Trading suspension following Bursa's rejection of the extension request for audited accounts.。
Net assets per share halved to 11.64 sen.。
